---
name: Pipeline template contribution
about: Submit an exported metadata-only pipeline template for maintainer validation
title: "[Pipeline template] "
---

Attach **share-this-template.json** from **Collect pipeline template.cmd**.
If the attachment service refuses JSON, append `.txt` to that filename.

Do not attach the private-recorder folder, shadercache, game files, shaders,
compiled binaries or logs. The export already contains the identifiers and
numeric pipeline state needed for review. Contributions are candidates;
maintainers must reconstruct and verify them locally before shipping them.

Optional: which track, car, camera or menu did you visit?

Player version:

Collection currently supports the normal 720p/1080p 16:9 translation with
anisotropy 16 and smooth colour enabled. Keep those settings throughout collection.
